title: US, South Korea Hold Nuclear Deterrence Talks as North Korea Expands Arms Push
snippet: US and South Korean officials discussed strengthening nuclear deterrence and readiness against North Korea's growing weapons programme at 6th NCG meeting in Seoul on June 11. Co-chaired by Kim Hong-cheol and Robert Soofer. Both sides reviewed CNI workstreams, signed NCG Security Guidelines for information sharing. Follows growing concern about NK expanding weapons-grade nuclear material capacity.
